enemy-029-siege-royal.designLock: Original project Siege Royal adaptation derived from the project's Praetorian and licensed Aliens: Colonial Marines caste grammar; Siege Royal is not an attested canon caste name and must never be described as an exact canon reconstruction. Heavy biped at Praetorian scale, with a substantially thicker ribbed torso, pelvis, thighs and forearms, powerful shoulders, and a broad low layered royal crest swept backward. The crest remains clearly smaller and less elaborate than a Queen crown and is not a Crusher head shield. Black/gunmetal wet organic chitin, dark-brown ridge edges, restrained battle scarring, ivory teeth; no heraldic colors. Eyeless narrow anterior dome and toothed maw with inner jaw; exactly TWO main arms and TWO digitigrade legs, with no Queen-like small chest-arm pair. Exactly four short reduced dorsal tubes remain below the crest. A single long segmented siege tail grows visibly from a thick sacral root and tapers to a sharp spear tip. No Queen ovipositor, no carried weapon, armor, shield, jewellery, cannon or mechanical implant. Strict right-facing side profile in every pose; never frontal or three-quarter. Preserve crest contour, heavy siege mass, tail root, limb count, palette, contact line and scale across all clips. The existing Praetorian render is a proportion and biological-grammar anchor only, not a request to copy it pixel-for-pixel.
